subjectLine: AI Powers Nation-State Attacks & Critical Zero-Days Emerge

articles.title: GreyVibe Hackers Leverage AI for Cyberattacks on Ukraine
articles.summary: A threat group, likely Russian and tracked as GreyVibe, is employing AI tools like ChatGPT and Gemini to craft sophisticated cyberattacks against Ukrainian entities. The group uses AI-generated lures and custom malware, highlighting the evolving tactics of nation-state actors.

articles.title: New Gogs Zero-Day Vulnerability Allows Remote Code Execution
articles.summary: An unpatched zero-day vulnerability has been discovered in the Gogs self-hosted Git service, enabling attackers to achieve remote code execution (RCE). This critical flaw poses a significant risk to internet-facing instances of the popular development tool.

articles.title: CISA Contractor Leaks Sensitive AWS GovCloud Credentials on GitHub
articles.summary: A contractor for CISA inadvertently exposed highly privileged AWS GovCloud account credentials and internal system details through a public GitHub repository. This leak could pose significant security risks to sensitive government infrastructure.

articles.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-0257) Under Active Exploitation
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks has issued a warning that a medium-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-0257) in PAN-OS and Prisma Access is being actively exploited. The flaw allows for authentication bypass, potentially enabling attackers to establish unauthorized VPN connections.

articles.summary: Hackers are actively exploiting an authentication bypass vulnerability in FortiClient Enterprise Management Server (EMS) to deploy an information-stealing malware named EKZ. This highlights a critical vulnerability in network management systems.

articles.title: Megalodon Attack Compromises 5,561 GitHub Repositories via Malicious CI/CD Workflows
articles.summary: A new automated campaign dubbed Megalodon has rapidly compromised over 5,500 GitHub repositories by injecting malicious CI/CD workflows. The attack uses forged identities to exfiltrate sensitive data from build pipelines, posing a significant risk to software development supply chains.

articles.title: Cisco Patches Critical CVSS 10.0 Flaw in Secure Workload REST API
articles.summary: Cisco has released a patch for a critical CVSS 10.0 vulnerability in its Secure Workload product, allowing unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive data. The flaw stems from insufficient validation and authentication in the REST API endpoints.

articles.title: Charter Communications Data Breach Affects 4.9 Million Accounts
articles.summary: The telecom giant Charter Communications has suffered a data breach impacting approximately 4.9 million accounts. Personal information was stolen by the ShinyHunters extortion gang, underscoring the ongoing risks to large customer databases.

articles.title: Global Powers Explore Humanoid Robots, Cyber-Risk Looms
articles.summary: As global powers increasingly focus on developing humanoid robots, significant cyber-risk implications are emerging. The race for dominance in embodied AI and its supply chain presents new frontiers for cybersecurity challenges and potential nation-state competition.

articles.title: AI Accelerates Exploit Development, Outpacing Scanners
articles.summary: New research indicates that attackers are leveraging Artificial Intelligence to significantly reduce the time required to develop functional exploits for known vulnerabilities (CVEs). This rapid development cycle is outpacing the detection capabilities of traditional security scanners.

articles.title: China's Webworm APT Targets EU Governments Using Discord and Microsoft Graphs
articles.summary: An advanced persistent threat group known as Webworm, attributed to China, has been targeting European governments. The group leverages platforms like Discord and Microsoft Graphs, along with SOCKS proxies, to facilitate its sophisticated attacks.

articles.summary: Unit 42 reports on Iranian APT group Screening Serpens' recent espionage campaigns, which utilize AppDomainManager hijacking and novel RAT variants. The group is specifically targeting the technology and defense sectors.

articles.title: ROADtools Framework Abused for Cloud Intrusions by Nation-State Actors
articles.summary: The open-source framework ROADtools is being exploited by threat actors, including nation-state groups, to conduct cloud intrusions. This article highlights the need for organizations to detect and mitigate the malicious use of this tool.
